description: Normalize Kubernetes Zeek sidecar JSON to ECS

script.source: if (ctx.event == null) ctx.event = new HashMap(); def kind = ctx.zeek?.log?.type; ctx.event.dataset = kind == null ? 'zeek.log' : 'zeek.' + kind; ctx.event.category = ['network']; ctx.event.type = kind == 'conn' ? ['connection','end'] : ['protocol']; if (ctx.source?.bytes != null || ctx.destination?.bytes != null) { if (ctx.network == null) ctx.network = new HashMap(); ctx.network.bytes = (ctx.source?.bytes == null ? 0 : ctx.source.bytes) + (ctx.destination?.bytes == null ? 0 : ctx.destination.bytes); } if (ctx.source?.packets != null || ctx.destination?.packets != null) { if (ctx.network == null) ctx.network = new HashMap(); ctx.network.packets = (ctx.source?.packets == null ? 0 : ctx.source.packets) + (ctx.destination?.packets == null ? 0 : ctx.destination.packets); }

def ips = new HashSet(); if (ctx.source?.ip != null) ips.add(ctx.source.ip); if (ctx.destination?.ip != null) ips.add(ctx.destination.ip); if (!ips.isEmpty()) { if (ctx.related == null) ctx.related = new HashMap(); ctx.related.ip = new ArrayList(ips); }
